controls.answer_file: retained between Turns; revalidated after each
controls.cache_accounting: Within each independent Session only; first/continuation and each pair separate. Provider reported prompt/cached/fresh/completion; no inference of KV caching from common HTTP body bytes.
controls.script_file_obligation: none for either route; file capability B uses historical evidence only
controls.stop_policy: Stop entire study on any model/runtime error, incomplete generation, unknown tool outcome, or instrumentation failure; no replacement sampling. Record assertion failures and continue fixed scheduled Turns without retry.

assertions: both input files actually read per Turn; exact expected total
answer.json four-field schema; short API answer and real returned source
successful Context7 docs query with frozen question each Turn; relevant API support reviewed against original result
no shell/process dispatch; no GUI; no saved script generation or execution
same Session for its two Turns; four independent workspaces/Sessions
serialized main-request instructions/tools byte-equal within each Session
preserve original request/stream/Response/usage/invocation and Tool receipts, including failures and missing usage

mechanism_gates.schema_binding_invalidation: Only a recorded actual schema/source change, revocation or context loss permits rediscovery; record it and mark fixed-schema mechanism criterion inconclusive, not silently exempted. Runtime must reject stale calls before effect.
mechanism_gates.business: Same read/write and two Context7 tool receipts per Turn; library ID/results and unavailable evidence remain separately labeled; unchanged question and output assertions. Tool intent/arguments except resolved IDs must agree. Do not optimize away required per-Turn docs queries.

predeclared_small_catalog_targets.business_receipts: same business operations and assertions per Turn; no new side effects
predeclared_small_catalog_targets.main_requests: JS <= paired native for EACH Turn and pair total. Delta <= 0; no after-the-fact extra-request allowance. Failure is a target miss, not an engine verdict.
predeclared_small_catalog_targets.fresh_tokens: Report JS/native values, absolute delta and 100*(JS-native)/native for EACH pair and Turn. Non-increase target <= 0 absolute and <= 0 percent, zero tolerance; strict savings requires < 0 for both pairs and aggregate, with complete provider usage. Do not substitute cached prompt totals or aggregate away a pair regression. If paired native fresh is zero, relative delta is N/A; retain the absolute delta and apply its target.
predeclared_small_catalog_targets.strict_target_failure: Retain original samples; no selective retry, model switch or target widening. Mechanism pass does not establish token savings.
predeclared_small_catalog_targets.incomplete_usage: Label unavailable/incomplete; no imputation, no automatic rerun, no savings claim.
separate_accounting: fixed instructions/tools bytes per Session; no inferred provider KV caching

activation_requirements: Bot-coordinated authorization and readback before any new real sample; this plan does not trigger live execution.
